meta.name: Monthly Magazine Home
meta.description:
A home-searching romance story about a man who buys houses and a woman who lives in one. It follows the diverse stories of the editors of a home magazine.

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16

videos.title: A Man Who Buys a House, a Woman Who Lives in a House
videos.overview: Na Yeong-won finds herself jobless and homeless overnight. A fresh start at Monthly Magazine Home doesn't get any better after seeing Yoo Ja-seong.

videos.title: Hope for My Own House
videos.overview: Taking notes from Ja-seong's YouTube channel on how to escape poverty and save money to buy a home, Yeong-won tightens her belt.

videos.title: Living with a Parasite
videos.overview: As Yeong-won's coworkers unknowingly try to foil her mission of spending less than $10 a day, Ja-seong emerges as her unlikely savior.

videos.title: If I Could Renovate My Life...
videos.overview: Ja-seong decides he's done helping out Yeong-won, who levies an unfair accusation against him after hearing spooky rumors about a past tenant.

videos.title: You Must Live in Your Home to Know it
videos.overview: Shin Gyeom comes clean about his secret. Yeong-won agonizes over her latest assignment: an article about Ja-seong.

videos.title: You are in My House, You are in My Heart
videos.overview: Yeong-won's constant compliments to everyone around her irks Ja-seong to no end. Meanwhile, Nam Sang-sun asks Yeo Ui-ju for a favor.

videos.title: He Lives in an Empty House
videos.overview: Ja-seong is adamant that no one at work can find out Yeong-won is staying with him. Yeong-won plans on cooking a thank-you dinner, but obstacles arise.

videos.title: House+Love=Home
videos.overview: A mystery man sends Yeong-won an expensive gift. After putting furniture in the house, Ja-seong eats the first homemade meal of his life.

videos.title: A Flower Blooming in a Ruined Heart
videos.overview: Ja-seong tries his best to hide a new relationship from his employees. A rip in a borrowed dress leads to an uncomfortable situation for Yeong-won.

videos.title: Long-standing House Long-standing Relationship
videos.overview: On Ja-seong and Yeong-won's date night at the movies, Ui-ju makes an unwelcome appearance. The magazine staff goes on an overnight volunteer trip.

videos.title: A Home Reflects its Owners
videos.overview: Yeong-won prepares a surprise birthday event for Ja-seong. A sudden call sends Ja-seong rushing to the hospital.

videos.title: Home, a Container That Holds Life
videos.overview: After Ja-seong suddenly turns his back on their relationship overnight, a sad and confused Yeong-won shows up at his door drunk.

videos.title: A Record of Youth's Home
videos.overview: While trying to get a hold of herself over the break-up, Yeong-won receives a heartfelt confession. Sang-sun starts to see Ui-ju in a new light.

videos.title: Meeting the Home of Your Destiny
videos.overview: Yeong-won keeps Ja-seong at a distance — until she learns the true identity of her supportive online friend. Elsewhere, Ja-seong goes on a blind date.

videos.title: Building a House, Building Love
videos.overview: The editor-in-chief catches wind of two co-workers dating in the office. In a surprising turn of events, Yeong-won recovers her security deposit.

videos.title: A Man Who Buys a House, A Woman Who Has a Home
videos.overview: After meeting the parents, Ui-ju and Sang-sun have an earnest conversation about marriage. Yeong-won finds her father — and a reason to part with Ja-seong.
